text_block_list.text: We did it! Victory is ours!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったにゃー！　
大勝利にゃー！！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for you, I couldn't have beaten that thing
with all the cats in the world!
You're the best, {0}!

キミがいなかったら
猫の手を借りても倒せなかったにゃ！
本当にありがとにゃ～♪
